## 1. One-paragraph verdict
A real differential-lane asset: `file` reports ISO Media MP4; live ffprobe gives `codec_name=h264, profile=Constrained Baseline, pix_fmt=yuv420p, r_frame_rate=30/1, nb_frames=30` — the frame count (30f) is truthful. The DIMENSIONS in the filename are not: ffprobe reports **126×94**, not 127×95 (yuv420p cannot express odd luma dimensions — x264 rounded the requested 127×95 down to 126×94 at encode time). The consuming differential knows the truth and encodes it correctly: the lane table at tests/h264_sw_differential.rs (od-verified) pins `name: "E_odd_127x95_30f", frames: 30, size: (126, 94)` with MD5 `d0fc84c9dc83f3df47e725db6d82c40f`, and `lane_e_odd_crop_annexb`/`lane_e_odd_crop_mp4` passed in the baseline (:1173-1174) against that truth. So the asset is real and correctly pinned; only its name overstates ("odd" survives only as "not macroblock-aligned": coded 128×96 cropped by 2/2 to 126×94).

## 2. What actually works (verified)
- `file` → "ISO Media, MP4 Base Media v1 [ISO 14496-12:2003]".
- `ffprobe` → h264 / Constrained Baseline / 126×94 / yuv420p / 30 fps / 30 frames (pasted in run log).
- Citation: h264_sw_differential.rs lane E (both Form::Es at :430 and Form::Mp4 at :435) — baseline :1173-1174 `lane_e_odd_crop_annexb ... ok`, `lane_e_odd_crop_mp4 ... ok` (part of the 17/17, 24.74s live-oracle run).
- The ES twin `E_odd_127x95_30f.h264` exists alongside (12,622 bytes).

## 3. Findings
F-001 [S4]
Where: fixture filename vs ffprobe truth
Code: (filename) `E_odd_127x95_30f.mp4` vs (ffprobe) `width=126 height=94`
What is wrong: the filename asserts 127×95; the file is 126×94 (yuv420p forbids odd luma sizes, so the encoder's odd request was rounded). The lane is named "odd_crop" but actually exercises a non-macroblock-aligned EVEN crop (128×96 coded → 126×94). No correctness impact — the test table pins (126, 94) — but the name misleads anyone reading the fixture list into believing odd-dimension decoding is covered (it cannot be, in 4:2:0). Confidence: HIGH — Verification: ran ffprobe + od-read the lane table.
